highlights: The AI agent ecosystem is maturing rapidly with critical advancements in secure execution environments and practical production architectures, enabling more robust and reliable agent deployments.
Developers are gaining access to a new wave of powerful, large-context, and multimodal frontier models, alongside optimized inference solutions and open-weight model APIs for diverse applications.
Major cloud providers are deepening their AI integrations and scaling their infrastructure to support enterprise-wide adoption, reflecting increasing demand for AI-driven solutions across industries.

agents.title: Anthropic’s sandbox-runtime: OS-Level Sandboxing for AI Agents
agents.summary: Anthropic open-sourced sandbox-runtime (srt), providing OS-level sandboxing for AI agents without containers, restricting file and network access to enhance security for agents and CLI tools.

agents.title: Google Cloud Launches Agent Compute Engine: A MicroVM per AI Agent
agents.summary: Google Cloud introduced Agent Compute Engine, a compute service that offers a hardware-isolated microVM for each AI agent, enhancing security and privacy by eliminating credential exposure for agent execution.

agents.title: OpenAI: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
agents.summary: OpenAI, in collaboration with PerturbAI and Scripps Research, deployed thousands of distributed AI agents to efficiently analyze complex biological data, successfully uncovering promising new research leads in millions of brain cells.

models.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context
models.summary: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, a powerful Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model featuring 2.8 trillion total parameters and a 1-million token context window, with open weights planned for release by November 4, 2026.

models.title: Google AI Blog: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
models.summary: Google has made Gemini 4 Argon, its latest frontier model, available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, providing advanced capabilities for tackling complex challenges.

models.title: Meta Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model
models.summary: Meta introduced Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, providing advanced capabilities for handling and generating diverse forms of media and data.

tools.title: OpenAI: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
tools.summary: OpenAI released the Decisions API, a new offering designed for developers to integrate fast, focused, and low-cost decision-making capabilities into any application, improving responsiveness and efficiency.

tools.title: You.com Launches Inference Router: 12 Open-Weight Models With 99.9% Uptime SLA
tools.summary: You.com launched an Inference Router, an OpenAI-compatible API that provides access to 12 open-weight models with a 99.9% uptime SLA, zero data retention, and server-side web search, enabling reliable and private AI integration.

tools.title: Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs
tools.summary: Liquid AI introduced RIPL, a real-time inference engine optimized for its LFM models, demonstrating significantly lower p95 latency (14.4 to 28.4x faster than vLLM) on a single B200, crucial for high-performance AI applications.

companies.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
companies.summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud announced a partnership to bring OpenAI's frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, making them accessible through the Google Cloud Marketplace for broader enterprise adoption.

companies.title: OpenAI: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
companies.summary: OpenAI detailed how it scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to achieve 12x faster reads for ChatGPT, demonstrating robust infrastructure capable of serving over a billion users.

companies.title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
companies.summary: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to over 30,000 employees, leveraging OpenAI's technology to empower teams with advanced capabilities for research, data analysis, presentation creation, and complex workflow completion.

learning.title: Stateful Agentic Engineering Copilots with Letta: Core Memory, Shared State, Semantic Retrieval, Custom Tools, Streaming, and Portable Agent Workflows
learning.summary: This comprehensive tutorial provides a guide on building stateful engineering copilots using Letta, covering advanced agentic memory beyond basic prompts, including inspectable core memory, archival vector retrieval, and multi-agent shared state.

learning.title: Google AI Blog: DevFest is back
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 returns with over 800 global events, offering developers opportunities to connect, build, secure, and scale their projects in the rapidly evolving agentic AI era through workshops and community engagement.

learning.title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
learning.summary: TinyFish published in-depth engineering research articles detailing a 7-phase production architecture for agentic search, emphasizing evidence contracts and bounded retries, and explaining design choices for deep research systems.
